sections.title: It started above Burton's.
items: Starts practising on 17 July in a few rooms above Burton's at 2–8 Broadway.
He talks the rent down from £200 to £175 a year for the first two years.
The firm becomes a limited liability partnership.
Now at 62 The Broadway, advising people and businesses across East London.
